findings.body: The previous CI gap remains open: forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 execute Python tests, while tests/test_mod_plugin.py:45–57 typechecks hooks without running the native interaction tests. The reported manual run verifies this revision, but automated checks still would not detect regressions in output selection, confirmation, hotkeys or surface rendering. plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md assigns the native plugin test job to SHIP, so that task should wire these cases into the automated suite.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must include the Machine native tests in CI
